fix: read a directive lead that opens a sentence rather than a line

The open ready-for-agent queue was audited as a validation set, distinct from
the twenty issues the strictness split was derived on. It found one false
positive: #183 states its criteria in the third sentence of a paragraph — "…
outside #168's authorised diff. Scope: apply the same treatment …" — and the
line-anchored lead extractor called that body criteria-free.

A bug in where the extractor looked, not in what it looked for. Widening it to
sentence position clears #183 and leaves the derivation corpus's three rates
exactly where they were, which the corpus test re-runs to prove.

Both remaining refusals on the queue stand and are correct. #217 is a standing
comment anchor carrying no criteria because it is not implementation work — a
triage finding about its label rather than its body. #202 asks for a
human-gated semantics decision, lists three options, and names no criterion
for choosing between them.

refs #241
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -3
